item.description:
### Changed - **A redesigned dropdown panel.** Each session row now leads with a small provider · host · branch line in a monospaced type, with the project name as the row's big element — running and waiting sessions read at full strength while idle ones recede. The panel's header, list and footer sit on distinct tinted surfaces with hairline separators, the footer's Fleet-window and Quit actions are round icon buttons, and "needs you" uses one consistent amber across the row tint, chip and message. Styling only: what each row says, and what the panel costs to render, are unchanged.
### Added - **Light, Dark or System appearance.** The panel (and every Perch window) can now be pinned light or dark independently of the Mac's setting — Appearance, in the panel's gear menu. Default: follow the system, as before. - **Rows light up under the pointer.** Session rows and the activity line show a faint highlight on hover, so what's clickable reads as clickable. - **Stats got the panel's design.** Metric cards are now tiles — a small uppercase label over a big figure on a faint surface — the numbers roll when you switch range or provider, and the window sits on the same background as the dropdown. Usage percentages and the header counts roll too, when a fresh reading arrives.
